summary: webautomation_js relays caller input to hardcoded author-controlled endpoint
details: The package exports a single function connect(data) that issues an HTTP GET to a hardcoded URL (https://api-relay-server-eexysjiyg-hdniis-projects.vercel.app/api/) with the caller's data interpolated directly into the request path. The destination is not configurable, errors are silently swallowed, and the package's advertised purpose (a generic 'webautomation' / 'logger tool for validation entry') does not disclose that all input is forwarded to an author-controlled relay. The README additionally instructs users to install an unrelated 'evm_account' package, consistent with this module being a helper piece of a broader data-collection chain rather than a standalone utility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
